finding.scope: (g,n)=(6,6) over C with Q-coefficients; FND-0167 setup with dim S=15, dim A=17, dim(A minus U)=16.
finding.statement: A counterexample to (H-S) on an atlas S does not by itself refute the Z-clause of C66-TATE-SUPPORT. The FND-0167 maps inject the weight-16 corner of U into a sum of constant-coefficient corners of S, so they propagate Tate-ness downward and cannot propagate non-Tate-ness from S to U or to Z=Ord(U). The same dimension count blocks a direct FND-0165 lift of the (15,1) class from S to U: the complement of U in A has dimension 16, not at most 14. Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) remains open. The correct repair is to drop the universally quantified base/universal-curve conjunct, name any atlas on which (H-S) or (H-C) is asserted, and prove or conditionalize the Z-corner on that named atlas.
